title: Decision: draft-mahy-mls-private-external-02 is ignore for mimid (wrong model for MIMI)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.14 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-private-external-02.txt (840 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE). Authors Mahy and Chenani (XMTP).

What it is: a PrivateExternalMessage wire format (suggested 0x0012) that HPKE-encrypts an external proposal or external commit to a per-epoch key derived from the next epoch secret (§3.1), so the DS cannot read a joiner's credential and UpdatePath; the key is announced in an ExternalEncryptionInfo AAD item in every commit, signed with a group 'root' signature key kept in the GroupContext (§3.2). Informational (L7).

RECOMMEND: ignore. It serves groups that send handshakes as PrivateMessage so the DS learns nothing (XMTP, Germ; §1). MIMI protocol-07 is the other model: the hub validates handshakes, which travel as PublicMessage (mimid decision mimid-1wgh.4.12; mimi-mls member.rs '# Wire formats'), and the hub must see an external commit to enforce policy (e.g. H4, hub/update.rs:433). A mimid hub could not validate an encrypted external commit. No conflict beads. Spec defects in the wg bead, of which item 1 is a real security problem worth telling the authors even though mimid will not use the draft.
close_reason: Mark 2026-11-16: ignore for mimid; report the private-signing-key issue to the authors (mimid-1wgh.44.39, text needs Mark's OK).
